name: Parallel Jumping Farthest Away (JFA) — Compute Shader
definition: An algorithm to speed up voxel grid computation where each invocation is at a triangle perspective. An AABB encapsulates the triangle, iterates through overlapping cells, and calculates distance using atomics.
summary: Parallel Jumping Farthest Away is a GPU compute shader method that accelerates SDF voxelization by using atomic operations for parallel triangle-voxel intersection seeding and massive GPU parallelism for the flooding phase.
